findings.location: Paragraph about gifting the army officer (source.html mid-late)
findings.source_quote: my husband left for another trip back to the village to “heap on coals of fire” by giving the angry army officer a solar panel and a transformer on top of the other things he demanded.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the mistranslation/typo for 'transformer' and consider a more literal/faithful rendering of the idiom “heap on coals of fire” (if desired by the editor). At minimum change 'محولة' to the correct Arabic noun 'محول'. Suggested corrected Arabic phrase preserving HTML structure/context: "...غادر هذا الصباح في رحلة أخرى إلى القرية ليُقدّم حسب التعبير الإنجليزي 'heap on coals of fire' بإعطاء الضابط الغاضب لوحًا شمسيًا ومحولًا بالإضافة إلى الأشياء الأخرى التي طالب بها."
